_comment: AI生成のプロンプト設定。文章は自由に書き換えてOK。{node_name}/{hint}/{style}/{type_desc} は自動で置き換わる。

background._comment: 拠点名から作る背景。『リアルとファンタジーの中間・書き込まれた高品質』を狙い、暗く汚くならないよう品質と明るさを重視。夜/暗めにしたい拠点は node_hints 側に書く。
background.template: A highly detailed fantasy landscape inspired by '{node_name}', a location in an epic fantasy world. {hint} Epic game key-art / concept-art, wide cinematic 16:9 composition, the left side kept a little more open and uncluttered so large title text can sit over it. {style}
background.style: masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, intricate details, sharp focus, crisp clean rendering, semi-realistic fantasy concept art, detailed digital painting, beautiful soft cinematic lighting, atmospheric depth, rich detailed colors, highly detailed scenery, no people, no characters, no text, no watermark
background.negative: lowres, low quality, worst quality, blurry, out of focus, jpeg artifacts, noise, grainy, muddy, dull, washed out, flat lighting, deformed, distorted, ugly, messy, bad composition, text, watermark, logo, signature, people, character, hands

node_hints.Kaia Pier: A fog-covered lakeside pier at night, dark still water, lanterns reflecting on the surface.

node_hints.Plains of Agris: Vast dark plains with waving grass, distant lightning, ancient standing stones.
node_hints.Bradie Fortress: A grim stone fortress with high walls and iron gates, siege scars, torches burning on the ramparts.
node_hints.Marni's Second Lab: A sinister alchemist laboratory ruin, glowing green vials, arcane machinery and crackling energy.
node_hints.Treant Forest: An enchanted forest of giant living trees, glowing spirit lights, roots covered in moss.
node_hints.Lynch Farm Ruins: A ruined haunted farm estate, dead trees, broken mansion silhouette under a pale moon.
node_hints.Northern Plantation: A vast plantation at night, rows of crops fading into fog, a dark manor in the distance.
node_hints.Hidden Monastery: A secluded mountain monastery, weathered stone statues, candlelight glowing in arched windows.
node_hints.Anti-troll Fortification: A heavy wooden and stone barricade wall in a mountain pass, spikes and siege defenses, snow falling.
node_hints.Crioville: A small fishing village at night, thatched roofs, mist rolling in from a dark sea.
node_hints.Orc Camp: A brutal orc war-camp, crude spiked palisades, bonfires, skull totems and rising smoke.

node_hints.Altar of Agris: A pagan stone altar on a hilltop, ritual fire, carved monoliths under a crimson sky.

node_hints.Inner Mansha Forest: A dark goblin-infested forest, crooked huts, glowing eyes in the undergrowth.
node_hints.Calpheon Siege War: A grand medieval capital city under siege at night, burning trebuchet fire arcing over massive walls and a gothic cathedral.
node_hints.Valencian Siege War: A golden desert palace city under siege, sandstorm at dusk, domed towers and war banners.
node_hints.Forest of Plunder: A lawless bandit forest, looted wagons, hanging lanterns, smoke between dark pines.
node_hints.Naga Swamplands: A vast murky swamp, half-sunken ruins, glowing green will-o-wisps over black water.
node_hints.Dernyl Farm: A lonely farmstead on dark plains, scarecrows silhouetted against a giant low moon.
node_hints.Forsaken Lands: A cursed barren wasteland, cracked earth, dead trees and ash drifting in the wind.
node_hints.Cursed Lands: A blighted land of black thorns and purple miasma, ruined shrines, ominous glow on the horizon.
node_hints.Old Dandelion: An ancient overgrown battlefield, a colossal weathered statue half-buried in flowering grass at dusk.
node_hints.Behr River Downstream: A wide dark river at night, mist over the water, old wooden bridge and reeds.
node_hints.Altinova Entrance: The grand desert gate of an eastern trade city at dusk, braziers burning, caravans' silhouettes.
